name: GhostTreeItem
description: Keyed role="treeitem" node (default <li>) and roving focus target. Sets aria-selected, aria-disabled, and for branches (a GhostTreeGroup inside) aria-expanded and aria-controls; links aria-labelledby to its first labelling GhostTreeTrigger so the name excludes child items. Row clicks select and, with expandOnClick, toggle; clicks bubbling from nested items are ignored.

props.name: as
props.description: Tag name or component rendered for the `role="treeitem"` node.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables selection, expansion, and roving focus for this node only.

props.name: textValue
props.description: Explicit typeahead label; defaults to the trigger or own text.

props.name: value
props.description: Unique, stable key used in `modelValue`, `expanded`, and focus tracking.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Item content: usually one GhostTreeTrigger and, for branches, one GhostTreeGroup.

states.name: disabled
states.description: data-state on a disabled, unselected item.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-tree-level
cssProperties.description: 1-based depth set inline on each GhostTreeItem; themes use it for logical indentation. Consumers may override it.

attributes.name: data-ghost-tree-value
attributes.description: GhostTreeItem element; carries the item value string (free-form, so no fixed values are listed).

attributes.name: data-selected
attributes.description: Present on GhostTreeItem and its GhostTreeTrigger while the item is selected.

attributes.name: data-expanded
attributes.description: On branch GhostTreeItem elements only; mirrors aria-expanded.

attributes.name: data-disabled
attributes.description: Present on the root, items, and triggers that are disabled (root or own flag).

attributes.name: data-level
attributes.description: 1-based depth on each GhostTreeItem (any positive integer; first levels listed).

keyboard.Tab: Moves focus into and out of the tree through its single roving tab stop.
keyboard.ArrowDown: Moves focus to the next visible enabled item without changing selection; wraps only when loop is true.
keyboard.ArrowUp: Moves focus to the previous visible enabled item without changing selection; wraps only when loop is true.
keyboard.ArrowRight: LTR: expands a closed branch, or moves to the first visible enabled child of an open branch. RTL: collapses an open branch, or moves to the closest visible enabled ancestor.
keyboard.ArrowLeft: LTR: collapses an open branch, or moves to the closest visible enabled ancestor. RTL: expands a closed branch, or moves to the first visible enabled child of an open branch.
keyboard.Home: Moves focus to the first visible enabled item.
keyboard.End: Moves focus to the last visible enabled item.
keyboard.Enter: Selects the focused item (single), deselects it when allowDeselect is true, or toggles it (multiple). Never toggles expansion.
Same as Enter when no typeahead query is active; otherwise appends a space to the query.
keyboard.*: Expands every closed enabled sibling branch of the focused item in one update.
keyboard.a-z: Printable characters run a 500ms typeahead over visible enabled items, moving focus without selecting.
